translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Sheep we e Mwaenirh Noa
Eew raaen nge ra noa ssow to rhooan iyoiyon tax me rhooa monofit ra itto aiussaening ngaeni Jesus.
Nge Pharisees me sinsein anniug kkewe a rhaepetae aar mwangiuniungiun pwe, “Mwaaeneei e aetiwaar rhooa monofit nge epwan mmwenen mwongo reer!”
Jesus a aeni ngaeniir fioangon awewe we:

“Aere igine erhai neeimi eyor epwiugiuw naiun sheep iwe nge erhai me neeiir e mwaenirh noa — meeta wopwene feeori? Wopwene nigitiir noa sheep kkewe tiweig me tiweman nge wa noa giutta fetaeneei manewe e mwaenirh noa ssiaaenin oamw noa rhuungi.
Igine wonoa rhuungi nge wopwene igin kker, nge wopwene ngaettae wooan eferoamw
nge wa pwigi noa nee iimw. Wopwene faingiir to weni maereyaeremw me rhooan no oaromw, wopwene aengaeniir pwe, ‘Iya igin kker pwe iya rhuungi sheep we naeyi iwe e mwaenirh noa. Sipwene oagupwuna!’
Iwe, ipwe aengaenigaemi pwe epwe pwan igin temoag kkeren weei naaeng wooan erhai man monofit e toagun saengi monofitin mmweer rhooawe tiweig me tiweman ikkiwe rese toagun saengi monofitiir.
Faiun Senaapiy we Eppiung Noa

“Aere igine eyor erhai rhooapwut eyor seig naiun faiun senaapiy nge efai eppiung noa — meeta niewe epwene feeori? Epwe figi eew oappwun, a peoni noan iimw we imwan, nge a aetemaeginiy aan giutta toori aan noa weri.
Oatona epwe noa weri nge epwene faingiir maereyaeren me rhooakkena reno oaron nge epwene aengaeniir pwe, ‘Iya igin kker pwe iya weri faiun senaapiy we eppiung saengiaei. Sia oagupwuna.’
Ipwe aengaenigaemi pwan ieen rhag taeppen aar kker angkenus kkewe naiun Deus igine erhai maan monofit a toagun saengi monofitin.”
Aetemwaaen we e Mwaenirh Noa
Jesus a soapwei noa nge a iura pwe, “Eyor erhai mwaaen reno riiurhai naiun aetemwaaen.
Aetewe egit a aengaeni pwe, ‘Semaei, ngoatto inetiiy me reen minikkomwu oamw.’ Iwe mwaaen we a giniiy minikkewe aan wooar aet riiurhai kkewe naiun.

Enoa mwirin fitowu raaen nge aetewe egit a chuwaiuw noa minikkewe aan nge a pwigi senaapian nge a siusaengi miniwe pwugusan. A noa wooan eew faniuw taaw noa, iwe a noa oasonopa noa senaapiy kkewe naiun reen wegitaeg kkewe e aenneew.
Iwe a noa oarosa noa senaapiy kkewe naiun. Nge enoa weni mwirin a noa itto eew naengeta ngaeni faniuw we, iwe a noa mwaenene noa aetewe.
Iwe a noa engaang ngaeni erhai aeremesaen faniuw we, aan engaang ina rhooan oamwongon sino.
Aetewe a gaen aeniaen pwe epwe mwongo minikkewe anan sino pwe igiwe esooar ne egaen ngaenneei anan.

Amwiucchiunoan igiwe aetemwaaen we enoa metaf noa wooan nge a iura pwe, ‘Oanongeer rhooan engaang kkewe naiun mwaaen we semaei nge e igin towunap aeneer nge ngaang iye ipwene oaropaen maen pecchai noa!
Ipwene iutae igina nge ipwene noa reen mwaaen we semaei nge iya aengaeni pwe, “Semaei, iya monofit ngaeni Deus nge iya pwan monofit ngaeniug.
Esa ferhanno ipwe ffai pwe ngaang noawumw; aeffitaegiaei noa rhag me rhooan engaang kkena noawumw.” ’
Iwe a iutae a sefaaen noa reen mwaaen we seman. “Aetewe e rhiuwen taaw saengi iimw we imwan nge mwaaen we seman a weri; a igin ffaiyeow, iwe a fattapw ngaeni, a roamito aetewe naiun nge a faeisongei.
Nge aetewe a iura pwe, ‘Semaei, iya monofit ngaeni Deus nge iya pwan monofit ngaeniug. Isa ferhanno ipwe ffai pwe ngaang noawumw.’

Nge faer mwaaen we seman a faingiir rhooan akkiuneo kkewe naiun, ‘Oaw mwetekkaei! Oawnoa pwigito mengaag na oarosaen mwamwaai oawpwe aememmengaagiu ngaeni. Nge oawwa iseni tae efai ring wooan aiuttiun nge oaw iseni tae nokkaan wooan pirheen.
Iwe nge oawwa noa oawpwe noa pwigito wakke na oarosaen soopwun oawwa itto niiy pwe oaw sipwene feeori eew gupwun faeregit pwe aan!
Pwe aetewe naeyi iwe a mae, igina a menaw; e mwaenirh noa nge igina iya weri.’ Iwe ra feeori gupwun we aar.
“Noan oatowe nge aetewe e tugufaeyi eno noan maat. Nge a noa sefaaeneto reen iimw we imweer nge a rongorong pwe ra pwai me wur.
A faingi erhai rhooan akkiuneo kkewe a aeiineow pwe, ‘Meeta a wen?’

Rhooan akkiuneo we a iura pwe, ‘Aet we pwiimw a sefaaeneto nee iimw, nge mwaaen we semoamw a aengaeniir repwe niiy noa wakke we oarosaen soopwun pwe igiwe enoa sefaaeneto nge esooar minne ewen ngaeni.’
Aet we e tugufaeyi a soong esa mwerhaen toonong no nee iimw; iwe mwaaen we seman a teeowow aeffaenipirhe ngaeni epwe toonong.

Nge iiy a appaniuwaeni mwaaen we seman, ‘Pipiiy, fiteig raeg aaei engaang ngaeniug taeppen aaen engaang erhai slave, nge esaaen yor mwo faaen eew ne i tipowwen ngaeniug. Nge meeta minne wo ngaenneaei? Erhai mwo goat nge wose ngaenneaei pwe aeipwe gupwun wooan me rhooakka maereyaerei!
Nge aete noawumw iye e oasonopa noa senaapiaen minikkewe wofang ngaeni wooar rhooapwutoi chuwaai, nge enoa rhag itto nge wa niiy ngaeni wakke we oarosaen soopwun pwe aan mwongoon gupwun!’
Mwaaen we seman a iura pwe, ‘Moawwerh naeyi, een wo nonno rhag oaroi, nge oanongaen minikka aaei nge eno pwe oamw.
Nge sipwe apwapwa pwe sa kker, pwe aetewe pwiimw iwe a mae nge igina a menaw sefaaen; e mwaenirh noa nge igina iya weri.’ ”
